app.js.reason: Fail-closed candidate merge (answer/solution conflicts become sticky and block formal admission) plus teacher-facing reliability fixes: the remembered view is restored before the first await, and a failed card edit is reported and rolled back to the stored truth. Then the deterministic MathType/MTEF restoration: the app's existing DOCX extraction path resolves each MathType OLE object through Qisi.DocxPipeline, keeps the formula evidence per file, and never reads the OLE control text. 2026-09-16: the DOCX SILENT WRONG CONTENT fix - the paragraph reader only reads real text elements (no structural element can become text), the flat question splitter moved to qisi-utils with the mark-sheet and image-token marker rules, and option evidence is only accepted from text that belongs to the question being filled. Then the support-file active anchor and the missing explicit answer rule: an answer/solution marker may sit behind an inline image token, and a 详解 conclusion such as 故选C is reported to the teacher but never written into the answer field.

qisi-pdf-support-controlled-write.js.reason: Question-number normalisation treats fullwidth digits as their ASCII form and rejects zero, so a phantom marker cannot own an answer. The controlled-write decision rules themselves are unchanged.
